candidate: Paratera (并行科技) Inner Mongolia New Computing Base, south end of the Yungu area, Horinger New Area, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia: campus locator for existing compute-base operations
method: The selected point is the station-site centre coordinate of the base's Phase 2 110 kV substation, printed in geographic degrees-minutes-seconds in the EIA report form published by the Inner Mongolia Department of Ecology and Environment on 14 July 2024 and repeated in the revised report published on 20 January 2025. It was transcribed arithmetically (deg + min/60 + sec/3600) with no datum transformation. The reports' neighbour descriptions, figure 4 (dated imagery of 21 September 2022 with outlined parcels) and the reproduced parcel plan were compared with an independent Esri World Imagery EPSG:4326 export.

selected_point.label: Paratera Phase 2 110 kV substation station-site centre, inside the Phase 2 land at the east end of the compute base

parcel_plan_context: Attachment 3 parcel plan (宗地图, 1:800, 22 February 2024; land-use right holder 内蒙古新东吉泰科技有限责任公司; 5,588.209 m2; sides about 69.9 m and 82.2 m) labels the north-west and south-west neighbours as 并行科技内蒙古新型算力基地 and the east and south sides as 祥荣路（云谷纵52路） and 云翅大街（新区横4路，机场快速路）. The plan prints no coordinates.

frame_check.imagery: Esri World Imagery EPSG:4326 export, request bbox 111.834,40.5375,111.848,40.5455 at 1600 x 1205 px (local esri-paratera.jpg, sha256 e04cf114...; companion f=json local esri-paratera.extent.json, sha256 5496f433..., returned extent 111.834-111.848E, 40.5362281-40.5467719N). Acquisition date not stated.
frame_check.observation: Read as WGS84/CGCS2000, the printed point falls at the north-east of a walled compound bounded east by a north-south road and south by the diagonal airport expressway, about 10-20 m north of a building at the compound's east end; the compound's west and centre hold three large roofed data-centre buildings, and the land north of the compound is vacant (the Bank of Communications parcel in the report's 2022 figure 4). This matches the report's description of the Phase 2 station on the east side of the base with Phase 1 adjoining on the west.
frame_check.gcj02_alternative: If the printed values were GCJ-02, the WGS84 position would be about 583 m west-south-west (111.835230, 40.540658), in open land west of the major north-south boulevard; that reading is rejected.
frame_check.manual_pick_accuracy: manual visual comparison on imagery of about 0.7-0.9 m per pixel and unstated accuracy

scope_and_uncertainty: The point locates the Phase 1-2 campus of the Paratera Inner Mongolia New Computing Base through its Phase 2 substation area at the campus's east end. It is not a data-hall footprint, parcel centroid or entrance, and it does not locate the base's Phase 4 project or any other later phase whose location is not established. No datum or positional accuracy is stated; horizontal uncertainty is left unquantified.
nearest_atlas_records: In verified_construction_core/2026-10-27-research-ninetysixth the nearest Atlas site is China Telecom Cloud Computing Inner Mongolia Information Park, 1.03 km west-south-west.
